project_summary: A lead-generation and payments platform with auth, admin controls, lead extraction jobs, saved searches, credits, and payment history.
discovery_goals: Suggest features grounded in the current backend API surface and frontend pages/components.
Prefer user-facing improvements that connect an existing backend capability to a missing frontend flow, or add a small new backend and frontend capability on top of an existing module.
Return multiple candidate features instead of a single suggestion when the project context supports them.
backend_context: Auth routes support registration, login, profile updates, and JWT-based authorization.
Lead generation includes jobs, leads download, credits balance/history, saved searches, and retry flows.
Admin routes support user management, credit approvals, stats, and job retry controls.
Payments routes support packages, order creation, verification, history, and history export.
frontend_context: Frontend has admin, auth, lead generation, payment history, job details, saved searches, and credits history pages/components.
Lead details already support CSV download from the job details view.
Payment history already supports export, but filtering and richer workflows can still be added.

feature_templates.title: Add failed job retry controls
acceptance_criteria: Users can retry failed lead generation jobs from the main jobs list
Admins can trigger a retry for failed jobs from the admin dashboard
Retry eligibility is enforced so completed or running jobs cannot be retried
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment history export
acceptance_criteria: Users can export their payment history from the payment history screen
Backend returns a downloadable payment history export scoped to the authenticated user
The export includes credits purchased, payment status, and timestamps
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add saved search alerts
acceptance_criteria: Users can enable alerts for a saved search
Backend stores alert preferences per saved search
Frontend shows alert status and lets users toggle alerts from the saved searches panel
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add credit history export
acceptance_criteria: Users can export their credit history from the credits history view
Backend returns a CSV export of the authenticated user's credit ledger history
Frontend exposes the export action next to the existing credits history table
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add admin user search and status filters
acceptance_criteria: Admins can filter users by email query, admin flag, and active status
Backend accepts filter parameters for the users list endpoint
Frontend exposes the filters in the admin users tab
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment history filters
acceptance_criteria: Users can filter payment history by status and package
Backend accepts filter parameters for payment history
Frontend exposes filter controls above the payment history table
Backend and frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add a marketing landing page refresh
acceptance_criteria: The product gets a clearer entry landing page with product value and call-to-action sections
Existing auth and dashboard routes continue to work
Frontend regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add payment package comparison and recommendation UI
acceptance_criteria: Users can compare available credit packages with better plan context
Frontend highlights a recommended package based on current pricing data
Payment purchase flow remains unchanged and regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Improve payment status and recovery experience
acceptance_criteria: Users get a clearer payment success, pending, and failed status experience
The payment status page suggests next actions for retry or support
Payment regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add profile security settings
acceptance_criteria: Users can manage password or security-related profile settings from the profile page
Backend validates and stores the change safely
Auth and profile regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add richer job details insights
acceptance_criteria: Users can see richer summary metrics and lead quality context on job details
Existing job and lead retrieval endpoints continue to support the page
Lead generation regression suites remain green

feature_templates.title: Add a dedicated saved search management page
acceptance_criteria: Users can manage saved searches on a dedicated page instead of only inside the lead generator form
Saved searches can still be reused and deleted
Saved search regression suites remain green

project_templates.title: Lead Generation Marketing Site
project_templates.summary: A standalone marketing and onboarding site for the lead generation product with pricing, feature pages, testimonials, and signup funnels.
project_templates.why_now: The current product has strong operational flows but no dedicated public-facing acquisition surface.
project_templates.market_value: A stronger landing and pricing experience can convert visitors who currently never reach the product flows.
market_research: Lead-gen products usually win trust with clear outcomes, proof, and pricing before asking for signup.
A public site creates a top-of-funnel path that the current dashboard-style product does not provide.
Search-driven pages and use-case pages can capture intent from teams already looking for lead sourcing tools.
growth_chances: Can become the acquisition layer for the existing product
Supports SEO, ads, demos, and sales-assisted signup flows
Can later branch into industry-specific pages and experiments
benefits: Better first impression for new users
Stronger signup and demo conversion flow
future_scope_ai: AI-assisted landing copy variants by audience segment
AI-generated use-case pages from product capabilities
AI chat concierge for qualification and plan guidance
project_features: Public acquisition funnel with clear lead-gen messaging
Package comparison and signup conversion flow

project_templates.title: Payments Operations Console
project_templates.summary: A dedicated internal operations project focused on payment health, failed payment recovery, refunds, and transaction support workflows.
project_templates.why_now: The current app already has payment verification, history, and admin controls that could evolve into a separate finance-support console.
project_templates.market_value: Payment support and recovery tools reduce revenue leakage and lower the time operators spend investigating failures.
market_research: Teams with growing payment volume usually split support and recovery tooling out from the main product UI.
Operators need transaction timelines, failure grouping, and next-step actions in one place.
Dedicated ops views become more valuable as payment states and support requests increase.
growth_chances: Can grow into a finance-support workspace
Supports refund workflows, escalations, and anomaly tracking
Can later integrate alerts and AI-assisted support triage
benefits: Less support guesswork across payment states
future_scope_ai: AI-based failed-payment clustering and root-cause suggestions
AI-generated operator summaries for support tickets
AI risk scoring for retries, refunds, and manual review
project_features: Customer payment timeline and status recovery

project_templates.title: Client Reporting Portal
project_templates.summary: A client-facing reporting product that turns lead generation jobs, saved searches, and exports into a polished reporting portal.
project_templates.why_now: The current platform already stores jobs, leads, saved searches, and payment history that can be packaged as reporting workflows.
project_templates.market_value: Clients often pay more for a polished reporting layer than for raw operational tools because it makes delivery measurable and easier to share.
market_research: Reporting portals are sticky because teams revisit them for exports, usage checks, and stakeholder reviews.
Existing job and saved-search data already gives this project a strong starting point.
A client-facing portal can differentiate the product from simple CSV-export workflows.
growth_chances: Can become a retained client workspace
Supports premium reporting and white-label delivery
Can expand into alerts, dashboards, and scheduled exports
benefits: Reusable reporting workflows on top of existing data
Stronger perceived value than raw exports alone
future_scope_ai: AI-generated report summaries and trend narratives
AI assistant for client questions about exports and usage
project_features: Reusable saved reports and report snapshots

project_templates.title: Agency Campaign Workspace
project_templates.summary: A separate campaign workspace for agencies managing multiple clients, searches, exports, and fulfillment status in one place.
project_templates.why_now: The current lead-generation and saved-search flows map naturally to multi-client campaign operations.
project_templates.market_value: Agencies need stronger multi-client coordination than a single-product dashboard usually offers, which makes this a good premium workflow product.
market_research: Agencies often juggle many client searches, exports, and fulfillment deadlines at once.
Campaign and client separation increases operational clarity and billable workflow value.
A workspace model fits existing saved-search and job-delivery concepts well.
growth_chances: Can evolve into a premium agency plan
Can expand into approvals, notes, and delivery SLAs
future_scope_ai: AI suggestions for next campaign actions
AI-assisted prioritization of campaigns and exports
project_features: Campaign delivery tracking and export queues
Operator handoff and notes across client workspaces

project_templates.title: Subscription Billing Hub
project_templates.summary: A billing-focused product for plans, renewals, invoices, payment recovery, and credit package lifecycle management.
project_templates.why_now: The existing package purchase and payment status flows can be expanded into a dedicated billing experience.
project_templates.market_value: Billing is a direct revenue surface, so improving plan management and recovery has immediate business upside.
market_research: Billing tools become more important once packages, renewals, and payment retries grow in complexity.
Customers expect receipts, invoices, renewals, and recovery flows to be more structured than a simple purchase screen.
A dedicated billing hub can serve both users and internal support teams.
growth_chances: Can support recurring billing and subscriptions later
Creates room for invoice workflows and account finance tools
Pairs well with payment operations and support tooling
future_scope_ai: AI detection of churn-risk billing patterns
AI-assisted retry timing and customer messaging suggestions

project_templates.title: AI Search Operations Studio
project_templates.summary: A focused AI-assisted operations product for search strategy, saved-search tuning, retries, export quality, and operator workflows around lead-generation results.
project_templates.why_now: Your current product already centers on search, saved searches, jobs, and exports, so an AI-augmented operations layer is a natural extension.
project_templates.market_value: AI support becomes most defensible when it helps users run better search workflows, not when it adds generic chat to unrelated pages.
market_research: Search-heavy teams need help refining queries, evaluating output quality, and deciding the next operational step.
Existing job, retry, lead, and saved-search data gives enough context for practical AI assistance.
AI is more useful here as an operator tool than as a generic page decoration.
growth_chances: Can start as an internal operator console and later become a customer-facing premium feature
Supports workflow optimization, quality scoring, and smarter retries
Can expand into guided search planning and delivery recommendations
benefits: Keeps AI tied to a real workflow surface
Improves search quality and operator speed
Creates a differentiated feature set around search operations
future_scope_ai: AI query rewrite and keyword expansion suggestions
AI quality scoring for generated lead sets
AI next-step recommendations for retry, export, or saved-search actions
build_requirements: LLM API access for query rewrite, summarization, and recommendation flows
Prompt/version management for repeatable AI behavior
Search-result evaluation pipeline tied to saved searches, jobs, and lead quality
Background job execution for AI suggestions so UI stays responsive
Usage logging, guardrails, and feedback capture for AI outputs
ai_tools: OpenAI Responses API for query rewrite, summaries, and recommended actions
Prompt templates stored per workflow step
Optional vector search later for similar saved-search patterns and operator memory

example_user.persona: Solo lead-generation operator or small sales ops team
example_user.scenario: You run ten saved searches every week. The AI studio tells you which searches are weak, suggests better keywords and locations, highlights low-quality result sets, and recommends whether to retry, refine, or export.
